title: Ultimate Vanilla Plus+
description: Ultimate Vanilla Plus+ is a performance-focused pack built to maximize your FPS and speed up loading times using top-tier mods like Sodium and Lithium. It keeps the game exactly the same as the original, just running much smoother and cooler on any PC.
body: I built this pack to make Minecraft run as fast as possible without losing the original feel of the game. It uses top-tier mods like Sodium, Lithium, and C2ME to boost your FPS, speed up chunk loading, and keep your computer from overheating. It's the same Minecraft you know, just smoother and much more optimized for any hardware. Enjoy the lag-free experience!
